t: You're looking at St Mary le Strand, a Church of England church at the eastern end of the Strand. Until 2021 it stood on a traffic island, just north of Somerset House. It was part of a big church building effort in the early 1700s, and it was designed by the Scottish architect James Gibbs, who also designed St Martin-in-the-Fields. It is the official church of the Women's Royal Naval Service. The bookseller and publisher Jacob Tonson is buried here.
